svg.title: Response-level coupling defect
svg.desc: What this figure shows: For this balanced binary family, the factorization defect is zero only at independence and grows with |rho|. The plotted object is generated from chi_A|B = TV(P_AB, P_A tensor P_B). How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Closed-form composition example. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
